text: PM will take minutes and place them in the shared folder; ID will present the working design.
UI will present the technical and usability aspects of the design, and UI will fill out the questionnaire after lunch.
ID will save the minutes in his documents.
Proposed decisions include Teletext being outdated with internet focus, and the remote control should be used only for the television.
Proposed decisions also target ages 16–45, keep the remote simple with big clear buttons, include a PIN-based parental control, and note budget and compatibility constraints.
